title: Migrating 600 PHP pages to WordPress without broken URLs
lede: A 22-person Dutch agency moved 612 URLs of custom PHP onto WordPress in five weeks. No dead links. The crawl, the rewrites, the MySQL port, and what broke anyway.
hero_alt: Overhead photo on bone linen: paper URL redirect map, 301 cheat-sheet, manila folder, brass plate, red wax seal.
